tasks.title: Write requirements doc
decisions: Scoped MVP to approve/request-changes flow; deferred agent chat to v2
7 configurable gate points matching existing pipeline phases
Reviews stored as JSON files per project, not in a database
Reuses existing doc viewer pattern for deliverable rendering

tasks.title: Technical architecture — data model, API design, pipeline integration approach
decisions: JSON files in flat data/reviews/ directory — consistent with heartbeats, meetings, work items patterns
reviewGates as flat boolean object on project schema — fixed set of 7 gates, not an arbitrary array
Gate checking integrated into heartbeatRunner findNextTask and task completion flow — minimal touch points
Per-task gate checking (not per-phase-level) so parallel phases like design+backend don't block each other
Changes-requested feedback loop: heartbeat re-runs agent with feedback appended, then resets to pending for re-review
No WebSocket push for v1 — dashboard polls on load, CEO checks reviews page on their schedule

tasks.title: Design spec — reviews page, gate config UI, deliverable viewer, approve/reject flow
subtasks: Designed two-column reviews page layout mirroring docs.html pattern (list left, detail right)
Defined review row component with status pills: pending (amber), approved (green), changes-requested (red)
Specified inline deliverable viewer reusing doc-content markdown rendering from docs.html
Designed approve/request-changes action bar with feedback textarea expand/collapse
Defined gate configuration section for projects.html: 7 compact toggle switches with phase-colored indicator dots
Specified dashboard metric card with pending count and red attention border when > 0
Added sidebar nav link with red badge counter for pending reviews
Defined keyboard shortcuts: A to approve, R to request changes, arrow keys for list navigation
Specified all responsive breakpoints: desktop two-column, mobile single-column with back navigation
Documented all interaction states, animations, accessibility requirements, and error states
decisions: Two-column layout (2/5 + 3/5 grid) matching docs.html — familiar pattern, no new layout concepts
Reuse doc-content markdown rendering for deliverable viewer — no new rendering infrastructure
Gate toggles save immediately on click (no save button) — atomic, non-destructive action
Submit Feedback button uses amber palette to signal 'this pauses the pipeline' — distinct from approve (green) and cancel (ghost)
Keyboard approve requires double-press (A then A again within 2s) to prevent accidental approvals
Mobile: review list and detail are separate screens with back-navigation, not side-by-side

tasks.title: Backend — review data model, CRUD API endpoints, project schema extension
subtasks: Created Zod schema for reviews with full validation (ReviewSchema, CreateReviewSchema, UpdateReviewSchema)
Defined VALID_GATES constant and GateName type for the 7 pipeline checkpoints
Built reviews store (CRUD) following heartbeats.ts flat-file pattern: create, get, update, list, getPendingReviewsForProject
Created reviews router with GET /api/reviews (filterable by status and projectSlug), GET /api/reviews/:id, POST /api/reviews, PATCH /api/reviews/:id
Extended ProjectSchema with ReviewGatesSchema (7 boolean flags, all default false) for backward compatibility
Extended UpdateProjectSchema to accept partial reviewGates for individual gate toggling
Updated updateProject store function to merge partial reviewGates (toggle individual gates without overwriting others)
Added pendingReviews count to dashboard metrics response
Registered reviews router in server index.ts
Validated all inputs: gate names, status values, required feedback on changes-requested, 409 on terminal states
decisions: Flat data/reviews/ directory (not nested by project) — volume is too low to need subdirectories, simpler aggregation
Partial reviewGates merge in updateProject — CEO can toggle one gate without sending all 7 values
409 Conflict on PATCH to already-approved/not-applicable reviews — prevents double-approval edge case
Feedback preserved on approval after changes-requested — CEO can see what they previously asked for
resolvedAt set automatically on approval or not-applicable — no separate timestamp management needed

tasks.title: Code review — backend architecture, security, reliability, performance
subtasks: Reviewed server/src/schemas/review.ts — schema design, validation rules, type exports
Reviewed server/src/store/reviews.ts — CRUD operations, file I/O, error handling
Reviewed server/src/routes/reviews.ts — API endpoints, input validation, state machine guards
Reviewed server/src/schemas/project.ts — reviewGates field addition, partial update support
Cross-referenced with store/projects.ts for reviewGates merge logic correctness
decisions: PASS verdict — backend is ready for QA with no blocking issues
Flagged path traversal risk in reviewPath() (pre-existing codebase pattern, not new) — recommend UUID validation on route params
Noted resolvedAt not cleared on changes-requested transition — defensive improvement, not a bug today
Noted getPendingReviewsForProject duplicates listReviews file-reading logic — maintainability concern at current scale
Approved feedback preservation on approve-after-changes-requested as deliberate design choice
Approved partial reviewGates merge in updateProject as correct implementation of tech approach

tasks.title: QA pass — API testing, edge cases, known issue verification, acceptance criteria validation
subtasks: Tested POST /api/reviews happy path — correct 201 response with all fields populated, UUID id, pending status, null resolvedAt and feedback
Tested POST validation: empty body (all required fields flagged), invalid gate name (rejected with list of valid gates), empty deliverables array (caught), invalid deliverable type (caught)
Tested GET /api/reviews with filters: status=pending, projectSlug, non-existent slug (empty array), invalid status (400 error)
Tested GET /api/reviews/:id: valid ID, non-existent UUID (404), path traversal attempts (blocked by Express routing), malformed ID (404)
Tested PATCH request-changes: happy path works, missing feedback rejected, empty feedback rejected (found minor duplicate validation message bug)
Tested PATCH approve: from pending, from changes-requested, double-approve (409), request-changes on approved (409), non-existent ID (404)
Tested gate configuration: partial toggles preserve other gates, individual gate toggle works correctly
Verified dashboard pendingReviews metric in API response (present and accurate)
Verified data integrity: all JSON review files valid after test operations
Verified known issues from design review and code review: confirmed deliverable URL bug, approve double-press bug, missing dashboard metric card
decisions: FAIL verdict — 2 major bugs must be fixed before shipping: (1) deliverable doc viewer uses wrong URL pattern (/docs/ + full path instead of /api/docs/ + filename), (2) approve button double-press confirmation fires on button click (should only apply to keyboard shortcut A)
Dashboard pending reviews metric card missing from dashboard.html — major gap in AC6 (dashboard visibility)
Minor: duplicate Zod validation messages when empty feedback is sent with changes-requested — cosmetic, not blocking
Atlas concerns validated: path traversal is mitigated by Express routing; resolvedAt behavior is correct for the existing state machine (approved is terminal, so resolvedAt never needs clearing)
Robert issue #1 (sidebar links missing) was resolved by Alice — all pages have the Reviews nav link
Backend API is solid — all CRUD operations, validation, state machine guards, and filters work correctly

tasks.title: Documentation — user guide for Pipeline Review Gates
subtasks: Read requirements, tech approach, and design spec docs to understand the full feature
Read the implemented reviews.html to verify actual keyboard shortcuts and UI behavior against spec
Wrote user guide covering: feature overview, gate configuration, reviewing deliverables, approve/reject flows, keyboard shortcuts, pipeline interaction, and API reference
Documented all 7 gate types with what gets reviewed and which agent produces each deliverable
Documented the double-press approve confirmation (A then A) to prevent accidental approvals
Explained parallel phase behavior (design gate does not block backend work)
Included API reference table with all review endpoints, query filters, and status codes
Documented known v1 limitations: no agent chat, no push notifications, no diff view
Matched tone and structure of existing bug-reporter-user-guide.md for consistency
decisions: Documented actual keyboard shortcuts from implementation (A, R, Arrow keys, Escape) rather than task brief (which listed J/K and X) — implementation is the source of truth
Kept API reference concise (table format) rather than full request/response examples — CEO is primary reader, not an API consumer
Included a 'Tip' for recommended gate configuration (After Architecture + After Design) as the highest-leverage review points
Structured guide as Quick Start then progressive detail — matches bug reporter guide pattern
